segments.he: פָּרִים הַנִּשְׂרָפִים וּשְׂעִירִים הַנִּשְׂרָפִים – שְׁחִיטָתָן בַּצָּפוֹן, וְקִיבּוּל דָּמָן בִּכְלִי שָׁרֵת בַּצָּפוֹן; וְדָמָן טָעוּן הַזָּיָה עַל הַפָּרוֹכֶת וְעַל מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב –
segments.en: With regard to «bulls that are burned and goats that are burned, their slaughter» is «in the north» of the Temple courtyard, «and the collection of their blood in a service vessel» is «in the north, and their blood requires sprinkling upon the Curtain» separating the Sanctuary and Holy of Holies, «and upon the golden altar,»

segments.he: מַתָּנָה אַחַת מֵהֶן מְעַכֶּבֶת. שְׁיָרֵי הַדָּם הָיָה שׁוֹפֵךְ עַל יְסוֹד מַעֲרָבִי שֶׁל מִזְבֵּחַ הַחִיצוֹן, וְאִם לֹא נָתַן לֹא עִיכֵּב. אֵלּוּ וָאֵלּוּ נִשְׂרָפִין אַבֵּית הַדֶּשֶׁן.
segments.en: and failure to perform even «one placement of their» blood «disqualifies» the offering. As for «the remainder of the blood» that is left after those sprinklings, a priest «would pour» it «onto the western base of the external altar, but if he did not pour» the remainder it does «not disqualify» the offering. «These,» the bull and the goat of Yom Kippur, «and those,» the bulls and the goats that are burned, «are» then «burned in the place of the ashes,» a place outside of Jerusalem where the priests would bring the ashes from the altar.

moves.summary: rules for burned bulls and goats
both kinds are burned at the place of ashes

positions.claim: burned bulls and goats are slaughtered in the north, their sprinklings indispensable, and they are burned at the place of ashes
